features.heading: FEATURES
features.title: Everything You Need for Your Motorcycle Journey
features.subtitle: Motorove brings together all the tools and connections you need to enhance your riding experience in one seamless app.

connectRiders.title: Connect with Riders
connectRiders.description: Build a network of like-minded motorcycle enthusiasts in your area and beyond.

discoverRoutes.title: Discover Routes
discoverRoutes.description: Explore the best motorcycle routes with turn-by-turn navigation and rider reviews.

joinEvents.title: Join Events
joinEvents.description: Find and participate in local rides, meetups, and motorcycle events.

shareJourney.title: Share Your Journey
shareJourney.description: Post photos, videos, and stories from your rides to inspire the community.

findRepairShops.title: Find Repair Shops
findRepairShops.description: Locate nearby motorcycle services with ratings from fellow riders.

weatherAlerts.title: Weather Alerts
weatherAlerts.description: Get real-time weather updates tailored for motorcycle riding conditions.

community.title: Join a Thriving Community
community.subtitle: Connect with thousands of passionate motorcycle enthusiasts who share your love for the ride.
community.networkDescription: Create your rider profile, connect with others who share your interests, and build a network of fellow motorcycle enthusiasts. Share tips, experiences, and advice with riders from around the world.
features: Join motorcycle groups based on brand, style, or location
Follow riders with similar interests and bikes
Create and share your custom routes with the community

routes.title: Discover Amazing Routes
routes.subtitle: Find the best motorcycle routes curated by experienced riders and share your own favorite paths.
routes.findRideDescription: Whether you're looking for scenic coastal roads, challenging mountain passes, or relaxed countryside cruises, Motorove helps you discover routes tailored to your preferences.
features: Route Reviews & Ratings from other riders
Create & Share your own favorite routes
Points of Interest along the way

events.title: Join Exciting Events
events.subtitle: Find local rides, meetups, and gatherings or organize your own events to connect with fellow motorcycle enthusiasts.

createEvent.title: Create Your Own Event
createEvent.description: Planning a group ride or motorcycle meetup? Create and promote your event within the Motorove community.
features: Easy event setup with location, route, and details
Invite friends or open to all community members
Track RSVPs and communicate with participants
Share photos and stories after the event

download.title: Ready to Join the Motorove Community?
